title: Figure 32: high-power FEL optical resonator dimensions
description: Simple line diagram of an optical resonator: two curved mirrors separated by S=16m, with a green undulator element of length L=0.6m at the centre and beam dimensions w=2.6cm, Z0=2cm and w0=0.1mm marked on the converging blue beam lines. Captioned "Figure 32. High-Power FEL Optical Resonator (courtesy of the Naval Post-Graduate School FEL Lab)." The page continues with estimated payload costs for Lightcraft launch using 10 MW laser systems.
